spans.text: Is it over...?
The number of connections are going down, but I already have what I want.
The experiment has been going on in this city for at least five years...
The consciousness of these failed Isomers have been merging and joining together the whole time, which actually makes it a lot easier for me to gather information.

OGAS... The original source code of this AI was compressed into a program called "Parapluie", which activates the moment it is implanted into a host, overwriting all operating systems into OGAS systems.
After the alteration, if the host cannot cope with the massive computational load...the Isomer will suffer brain damage, and in a T-Doll's case, the neural cloud will be fried.
Which is why at Griffin, other than M4, all the other Dolls are failures... I knew it - Persica has everything to do with this.
Looking at it this way, once a Doll has contracted the virus, there are only two possibilities - either she experiences a neural meltdown, or she becomes a host for OGAS.
Which means the fellow in my base layer is also a simulation derived from a feeble OGAS...
Should I be thankful for the fact that my neural cloud has very limited space, or that my OGAS isn't particularly "clever"?
Still...I think I finally understand what really happened during the Butterfly Incident.
Why they chose us... Why they chose M16... It all makes sense now.
Since that time, we've been pawns on the chessboard... And now I've finally figured out what exactly these chess pieces are for.
I am getting closer and closer to the truth.
But M4A1 is clearly the key to this entire business, and she's so powerful, so why hasn't she done anything up till now?
Tsk. The connection is shifting again... An external connection.
No...this doesn't feel right. Is it already time to wrap up this operation?
Can...can you move?
Ja, I can! Did 45 win?
But what happened to that weird, mumbly enemy?
That body has been abandoned.
45 slowly gets to her feet. She gives the Isomer who's cupping M4's cheek a light shove, and the Isomer topples onto the ground like a corpse.
Oh, 45! Are you alright?
Thanks to them, I managed to escape from the connection maze.
(Coughs)
Is this the real world...?
Welcome back, AR Team.
I know you're still feeling groggy, but I'm guessing the worst is about to happen any second now, so I suggest you smack yourselves awake and get moving right away.
You're...the leader of Squad 404? Don't worry, I've sent away the Isomer who's been causing the interference. It's over.
15, are you alright? I think we'll have to acquire access authorizations for the quarantine wall some other way, but since the interference has been neutralized, it shouldn't be too danger—
BOOM!
The sound of a massive explosion comes from the distance, followed by a series of continuous blasts.
What's going on?!
Huh?!
Is it a bombardment?!
"It's over"? No, no, I believe you're terribly mistaken. This is the exact moment the enemy has been waiting for.
Back when we broke free of the virtual space, I sensed a new connection between the Isomer and somewhere outside Tallinn. Do you know what that means?
...A connection with somewhere outside Tallinn?
That thing in your mind is likely the target that the culprit behind everything is after, and you gave it away just like that.
Now that they've achieved their objective, their next step would be to bury us all here.
What...
M4, 15, you're okay! Hmm? When did you get here, Squad 404?
All of us were under attack from the forced connections, so we came over to regroup.
Is that so...? But we have more important things to discuss.

Just now we received word from the Commander that Tallinn City Station came under artillery fire. Our forces have detected a military armored train heading straight for us, so we have to rush back and set up our defenses!
A few minutes ago.
Outside of Tallinn.
In the command center on board the Intercontinental Railway.
Good news, Commander! The interference affecting our Dolls has been neutralized!
We've been hearing from our echelons - everyone is safe, no casualties.
Understood.
I'm guessing the AR Team must've done something...
Keep an eye on enemy movements.
Have our echelons resume their original mission.
Roger that!
Now we just have to wait for their next report...
An incoming transmission.
Commander, this is Squad Desert Eagle!
Our Leader told me to inform you that they'd spotted something moving at high speed towards you via another railway track which goes through Tallinn!
Oh, I can see it from here! Looks like a massive train— Holy—!
M1895 CB's report is interrupted by a deafening boom.
M1895 CB?! Are you alright?!
Cough... All our signals are still accounted for. We're fine...
That train is mounted with multiple cannons... Watch out, Commander...
Acknowledged.
M1895 CB, tell your team to follow the original plan and proceed to the next rallying point.
Understood! We'll be on our way!
BOOM!!!
As the blast goes off, the entire train shakes violently.
The lights installed on the ceiling keep flickering and go out eventually.
I grab hold of the edge of the desk to keep my balance, then I snatch up my tablet from among the objects that have scattered all around in the tremors and activate the comms channel.
Kalina?!
Commander, I'm okay!
How is it on your end?
I'm alive, no injuries.
Take stock of our casualties... Never mind, leave it.
Order all echelons to stick to the original plan and execute Operation Golden Fleece at once.
Are we really carrying out such a risky plan?
The quarantine wall is still closed; even if they manage to open it, there's no guarantee that we can escape.

So let's give those disgusting stalkers a little surprise. Besides, to be completely honest, Havier is such a tightwad for giving us this rickety train. I want to switch to something bigger and comfier.
Commander... This is way too reckless... But who cares? Since when have you NOT been reckless?
It's about time we showed those green bastards we aren't to be messed with!
Meanwhile, 416, who's currently scouting the area from a high vantage point in the city ruins, spots a giant mechanical beast making a beeline for Tallinn.
The fading sunset does nothing to soften its harsh outline. Instead, it dyes the armor plates a horrific shade of blood.
That looks like extremely bad news...
As the dual-rail train approaches, its cannons swivel around to point straight at Tallinn City Station.
What's the situation?
It appears to be a military armored train. Whoever sent this seems dead set on blowing us to kingdom come.
That's only to be expected. This entire city is worth absolutely nothing for them.
Worst case, we'll have to give our friends the slip. Armored trains are far beyond what we can deal with.
How will the Commander fare against this?
The Military couldn't have sent a single train. The Commander might be able to handle one, but when the Military launches a saturation attack, even the Commander won't last long.
Tsk...
So, dearest friends from the AR Team, now that we find ourselves in such a dire situation, how should we prepare for what's to come?
I just got in touch with the Commander. All Griffin echelons have already repositioned. For some reason, I have a feeling that the Commander anticipated this...
Right now Miss Kalina is dispatching supplies and Dummies to our forces. As for us, we've been told to head back and help set up a defense line.
Set up a defense line, eh...? Looks like you still have time, M4.
What do you mean?
The Parapluie virus is irreversible. You don't really believe that OGAS has disappeared from your neural cloud for good, do you?
I don't understand what you're getting at.
Oh? Then let me put it this way - don't you intend to retrieve the important thing that you've lost?
I...haven't lost anything important.
Ah, so you insist on keeping that secret?
I see. You're planning to run away from the whole thing.
45 walks up to M4 with a smile. She suddenly grabs M4 by the collar and jerks her right up to her own face.
Are you freaking kidding me?! Do you still think of yourself as a tragic heroine?
What are you doing? Let go of her!
45 releases her grip on M4 and shoves her back.
I thought the AR Team was oh-so-amazing; your leader has such a mighty body and a neural cloud that can even contain OGAS. But it seems that's just a total waste of your brilliant specs.
What are you talking about?
Can't you sense it? Your leader is always doing things that defy Doll logic. Don't you think she's hiding something?
What are you not telling us, M4??
I think it's time you let us in on your secret. I told you before - we're your backing. You no longer have to bear this on your own.
Ja, you ARE special, but if you let this go on, you will end up getting yourself, your team, and the entirety of Griffin killed.
This is the moment of truth, M4A1.
This decision may cost you your peaceful status quo, but running away will cost you your the entire future.
You think just because that voice disappeared, everything's over? No, this is merely the beginning!
I...understand.
